product_metadata.title: Linenspa Waterproof Mattress Pad with Quilted Microfiber Cover -
features: Soft, hypoallergenic microfiber fabric over a noiseless waterproof barrier offers quiet and comfortable mattress protection
description: Comfort, protection and value come together with the Linenspa Waterproof Mattress Pad. Plush microfiber fabric and soft down alternative fabric rest on top of a thin liquid-proof barrier that guards your mattresses from fluids and accidents. Diamond quilting ensures a smooth, even surface that's quiet and breathable, and corner elastics secure the pad to the mattress. Machine washable mattress pad makes it easy to keep your sleep surface clean and fresh.
